prompt: This photorealistic photo captures a sterile hospital corridor with polished linoleum floors reflecting the overhead fluorescent lights. On the left side, an elderly woman in a floral blouse sits on a hard plastic chair, her posture slumped in exhaustion. Next to her stands a young nurse in blue scrubs, who is gently handing a paper cup of water to the seated patient. In the center of the frame, a tall man in a grey suit walks briskly toward the camera, his eyes fixed on a smartphone held in his right hand. To the right, a security guard in a dark uniform leans casually against the wall, pointing toward a distant exit sign while speaking to a visitor in a yellow raincoat standing beside him. A small potted fern in a white ceramic pot rests on the floor near the guard's feet, adding a touch of green to the clinical setting. Further down the hall, a cleaning cart with bright orange buckets is parked near a closed door. There is no blood visible anywhere in the scene, maintaining a calm and routine atmosphere despite the busy environment. The lighting is even and cool, highlighting the textures of the walls and the expressions of the individuals present.
